target_customer: HR, finance and people teams at tech companies that plan and benchmark pay
problem: Compensation decisions were made in spreadsheets with stale survey data; Pave connects to HRIS, ATS and cap table systems for real-time benchmarks.
business_model: B2B SaaS subscription with free benchmarking as a data and lead engine

founders.name: Matt Schulman
education: University of Pennsylvania, engineering and Wharton business degree (M&T program)
founders.background_notes: From the YC page; Pave's site lists him as founder.

technical_complexity.rationale: Many HRIS, ATS and cap table integrations plus privacy safe benchmark aggregation; standard SaaS with a hard data pipeline.

defensibility.rationale: Benchmark data improves as more companies connect, and comp planning workflows lock customers in.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: Pave acquired Option Impact from Morgan Stanley in June 2022; Carta launched Total Comp in April 2021 per a search summary.

market_need_then: Remote work and fast hiring in 2020 made pay transparency and market benchmarks urgent for startups, which relied on spreadsheets and expensive annual surveys.

branding.name_origin: Pave is a rebrand of Trove; the team could not agree on a price for Trove.com and acquired Pave.com through a broker, per Media Options and DomainInvesting summaries.
branding.domain_note: Bought pave.com in 2020 for an undisclosed fee through a broker (Grit Brokerage), per DomainInvesting; earlier used trytrove.co.

identity.logo: Blue mark with dark blue wordmark per the site

branding.brand_signature: Free real time compensation benchmarking launched in 2021

rebrands.why: Could not buy Trove.com; acquired Pave.com instead, announced with the Series A

branding.community_and_virality: Domain trade blogs wrote about the pave.com purchase; no merch or fan accounts found.

brand_strength.rationale: A short exact match .com name chosen early, named customers like Databricks and Stripe on the site, and a unicorn valuation by 2022.

outcome_analysis: Pave raised a 16 million dollar Series A led by a16z in December 2020 while rebranding from Trove, a 46 million dollar Series B at 400 million dollars in August 2021, and a 100 million dollar Series C at 1.6 billion dollars in June 2022 with the Option Impact acquisition. Its connected benchmark data and planning workflows created a data network effect, and it now claims over 9,000 integrated companies. No layoffs or exit were found.
notes: The BusinessWire Series A page returned 403; its facts come from search summaries (as does the Series B lead: YC Continuity per one summary versus a16z, Bessemer and Craft per Clay; investors listed here are those both versions name or the BusinessWire headline supports). Media Options says 950,000 dollars of funding was secured by March 2020; that pre-seed is not recorded as a round. Competitor searches returned only post 2020 pages (Carta Total Comp April 2021, Option Impact and Radford undated), so the list is empty. Founded 2019 per the Pave site (October 13 2019); aggregators give 2012 or 2016, treated as errors. Pave was Trove in the YC S20 period.
